Madhya Pradesh to Relaunch State Bus Service After 21 Years

Madhya Pradesh is set to relaunch its state bus service after a 21-year hiatus. The 'Apni Bus' service will begin with 351 buses. Union Minister Nitin Gadkari is scheduled to flag off the 'Mukhyamantri Sugam Parivahan Seva' (Chief Minister's Easy Transport Service) on Tuesday. The service will initially operate in seven cities.
